package.name: open_amr_wms
package.description: Warehouse management for the OpenAMR Swarm: offers tasks to the decentralized fleet (never assigns robots), keeps the bin inventory (SKU and box per bin) and the task history in SQLite, resumes from the robots' heartbeats after a restart; orders, customers and inbound receipts (ASN) in by CSV / JSON / REST; operator commands, an event log, a LAN dashboard and shift reports.
